result.summary: Wrote lit.md for s802/r3 covering the four literature topics (L1 reliability-ratio screen-vs-shrinkage, L2 price-limit/board/listing-age conditioning of order flow in China, L3 overnight-vs-intraday return decomposition, L4 redundancy of overlapping long-only decile books) from analysis.md §5. For each topic, listed operator-translatable treatments tagged to a references list of 21 sources (18 verified:true via direct search/fetch confirmation, 3 verified:false where only secondary/unconfirmed), all dated before 2023-08-08. Explicitly flagged two on-topic papers found but excluded for being dated after the cutoff (Sobotka 2025; Guo/Han/Li/Li 2024), and explicitly marked sub-questions where no direct literature hit was found rather than fabricating one (notably L1(a)-(c) on autocorrelation-as-reliability and screen-vs-shrinkage head-to-head comparisons, L3(b) on the sign of China's overnight/intraday pattern, L4(b)-(c) on combination-method comparisons and marginal-contribution decay curves).
